Specification: This module provides a formalization of differential equations and their solutions in TLA+. It defines what it means for a function to be a first derivative (IsFirstDeriv) and recursively defines higher-order derivatives (IsDeriv). The Integrate operator expresses the existence and construction of a solution to an n-th order ordinary differential equation with given initial values, using a choice function to select a suitable solution. The module uses real numbers and sequences, and encodes open intervals and neighborhoods for analysis, but does not specify a particular algorithm or system beyond these mathematical definitions.
